data.long_meaning: The name Safeek is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Safik' which means 'Protector' or 'Guardian'. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and symbolizes the idea of protection and security. The name Safeek carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Safeek usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
